meta.note: Policy-rate step series supplied by the lead economist from domain knowledge, NOT fetched from a publisher in this session. Held in a separate file from the fetched data so provenance stays auditable: everything here carries confidence 'analyst-supplied'. These two series were omitted by the data-sourcing pass because no complete machine-readable step series was reachable, but without a policy rate the DR007 spread, the real policy rate and the whole liquidity index cannot be computed — so they are supplied here deliberately and flagged. VERIFY AGAINST THE PBoC BEFORE ANY PRODUCTION USE.
cross_checks: PBoC Monetary Policy Report anchors independently extracted by the data pass agree with this series at every point it could read: 2.55% across 2019-Q1..2019-Q3, 1.50% at 2025-03, and 1.40% at 2026-03.

The 1.50% -> 1.40% cut is dated here to 8 May 2025. The fetched RRR series independently records a large-bank RRR cut to 9.00% effective 15 May 2025, corroborating a May 2025 easing package rather than a later one.

omo_7d.name: 7-day reverse repo rate (policy rate)
omo_7d.notes: Step series: only change dates are recorded; the build pipeline forward-fills onto the monthly grid. Series begins 2015-10-26; the January-September 2015 easing sequence is omitted because the intermediate levels could not be stated with confidence. Since the June 2024 framework reform this is the PBoC's single primary policy rate.

mlf_1y.name: 1-year MLF rate
mlf_1y.notes: Step series. DELIBERATELY ENDS MARCH 2025: from the March 2025 operation the PBoC moved the MLF to multi-price (variable-rate) bidding, so no single announced MLF rate exists thereafter. That termination is itself the signal — it is the operational moment the MLF stopped being a policy rate and became a pure liquidity tool. Do not forward-fill 2.00% past this point.
